## Automated Tests Required

### GRID-002 — Solidity Formula and Coordinate Conversion (Logic)
**Test file path**: `tests/unit/grid_system/grid_solidity_coords_test.gd`
**What to test** (from story AC-D3.1–D3.4, D2.2, D2.3, D4.1, C5.1):
- `is_solid()` formula: `NOT buildable OR occupant_id != -1`
- `access_ids` must NOT participate in solidity (AC-D3.1, AC-C5.1 — same assertion, two framings)
- `occupant_id` overrides regardless of `access_ids` (AC-D3.2)
- `buildable=false` is always solid regardless of `occupant_id` (AC-D3.3)
- **`occupant_id == 0` is legal and must NOT be treated as falsy** (AC-D3.4) — the GDScript `if occupant_id:` trap
- Out-of-bounds queries `push_error()` + safe default, no adjacent-row/column data leak (AC-D2.2)
- Out-of-bounds `is_solid` returns `true` (AC-D2.3 — "outside = solid", prevents AStarGrid2D pathing into void)
- `grid_to_world_corner` / `grid_to_world_center` / `world_to_grid` round-trip consistency (AC-D4.1)

**Edge cases to cover**:
- `access_ids = []`, `[7]`, `[7,8,9]` — all must return `is_solid = false`
- `occupant_id = 0` specifically (first piece placed) — the highest-value regression case
- All 8 OOB directions (4 corners + 4 edges) against a fixture where OOB would leak into a real adjacent cell if `flat_index` bounds-checking were skipped
- `cell_size` odd number, cell at origin `(0,0)`, cell at max boundary `(width-1, height-1)`
- `world_to_grid` must NOT clamp — OOB output like `(-1,-1)` is expected/normal during drag

**Estimated test count**: ~15–18 unit tests (8 AC, several with 2-4 edge-case variants each)

### GRID-003 — Rotation Transform and Declared Bounds (Logic)
**Test file path**: `tests/unit/grid_system/grid_rotation_test.gd`
**What to test** (from story AC-C4.1–C4.3, D1.1, D5.1–D5.3):
- 4-branch rotation transform (0°/90°/180°/270°) matches the GDD D.1 table exactly, for **two independent non-square fixtures** (1×2 treadmill, 1×1 squat rack) — cross-validated against each other
- **Union bounding box, not footprint-only bbox** (AC-C4.3) — this is the GDD's single highest-risk rule; the negative test must fail if the union bbox regresses to footprint-only
- Illegal rotation values (45, -90, 360) trigger `assert(false)`, not a silent fallback (AC-D1.1)
- `declared_bounds()` computes `(W,H)` from footprint ∪ access, not footprint alone (AC-D5.1)
- Debug asserts fire on anchor-convention violation and empty footprint (AC-D5.2, D5.3)

**Edge cases to cover**:
- **MUST include 90°/270° cases, not just 0°/180°** — symmetry at 0°/180° can hide bugs (explicitly flagged in the story's own QA notes)
- Access cell coordinates must have both components `>= 0` after rotation (catches the footprint-local-bbox regression specifically)
- Un-normalized raw data (pre-anchor-normalization) should trigger the assert; post-normalization data should pass
- Each illegal rotation value tested independently; valid values confirmed to NOT trigger the assert

**Estimated test count**: ~14–16 unit tests (this story carries the highest defect risk in the sprint — do not under-test the 90°/270° branches)

### GRID-004 — Placement Validation — can_place (Logic)
**Test file path**: `tests/unit/grid_system/grid_can_place_test.gd`
**What to test** (from story AC-C6.1–C6.5, C5.2–C5.5):
- All 5 FAIL codes trigger independently and in the documented early-exit order: `OUT_OF_BOUNDS` → `BLOCKED_BY_ROOM_GEOMETRY` → `OVERLAPS_EXISTING_EQUIPMENT` → `ACCESS_OUT_OF_BOUNDS` → `ACCESS_BLOCKED_BY_ROOM_GEOMETRY`
- Footprint OOB and access OOB return **different** error codes (AC-C6.4) — assert on the enum value itself, not just "it failed"
- `can_place()` is provably pure: full-grid snapshot before/after is exactly equal, no `push_error()` on expected FAIL paths (AC-C6.5)
- Access-cell overlap is allowed by design — two equipments may share an access cell (AC-C5.2)
- Access-on-another's-footprint is allowed by design (AC-C5.4) — this is Pillar 2 ("place it too close, see nobody can use it"), not a bug
- Zero access cells (`access_cells = []`) is legal — decorative/storage equipment (AC-C5.5)

**Edge cases to cover**:
- All 4 grid edges tested independently for OOB; corner placement partially OOB
- Exactly-overlapping vs partially-overlapping footprint collision
- 3+ equipments sharing the same access cell
- Valid placement also produces zero state mutation (not just invalid placements)
- Verify `get_access_cells()` returns `[]` (not null) for zero-access equipment

**Estimated test count**: ~13–15 unit tests

### GRID-005 — Commit, Clear, and Reverse Index (Logic)
**Test file path**: `tests/unit/grid_system/grid_commit_clear_test.gd`
**What to test** (from story AC-C7.1–C7.3, C7.7, C7.8):
- `commit()` → `clear()` round-trip restores `occupant_id = -1` and removes `access_ids` entry, proving the reverse index (not a full-grid scan) drove the clear (AC-C7.1)
- Duplicate `instance_id` commit is rejected via `push_error()`; the **old** record is untouched (atomic decision, rejection happens before any cell write) (AC-C7.2)
- `clear()` on a never-committed id: `push_error()`, full snapshot before==after, `grid_changed` NOT emitted (AC-C7.3)
- Negative `instance_id` (`-1`, `-5`) rejected on `commit()` — protects the `-1` sentinel (AC-C7.7)
- **Advisory/code-review only**: id-reuse after clear is accepted without error — this is PlacementSystem's contract to honor, not GridSystem's to enforce (AC-C7.8) — verify this is documented as a code comment near `commit()`, not asserted as a pass/fail test

**Edge cases to cover**:
- Clear an equipment with a 2×2 footprint (not just 1×1)
- Clear an equipment with 0 access cells
- Test `-1` specifically (the sentinel) and also `-MAX_INT`
- Verify rejection happens **before** any cell write (no partial state corruption)

**Estimated test count**: ~10–12 unit tests (+1 code-comment verification, not a runtime assertion, for AC-C7.8)

### GRID-006 — GridStateReader and GridSnapshot (Logic)
**Test file path**: `tests/unit/grid_system/grid_state_reader_snapshot_test.gd`
**What to test** (from story AC-GSR.1–GSR.3, X.2, X.3):
- Polymorphic consistency: `is_solid`/`get_occupant_id`/`get_access_cells`/`get_dimensions` return pairwise-equal values whether called on the live `GridSystem` or its `get_snapshot()` (AC-GSR.1)
- `get_dimensions()` correctness and preservation through snapshotting (AC-GSR.2)
- **Deep-copy semantics**: a snapshot taken at state T must NOT change when the real grid later mutates to T′ (AC-X.2) — explicitly verify the `access_ids` Dictionary is duplicated, not shared by reference
- Speculative snapshots never touch real storage: `_commit_in_place`/`_clear_in_place` on a `GridSnapshot` must leave the real grid unchanged and must NOT emit `grid_changed` (AC-X.3)

**Edge cases to cover**:
- Test with overlapping `access_ids` (two equipments sharing an access cell) before snapshotting
- Test after a commit+clear sequence, not just a static state
- Speculative deltas that both add and remove the same piece; empty deltas array

**Estimated test count**: ~10–12 unit tests

**Code review checklist item (AC-GSR.3, ADVISORY — not automatable in GDScript, which has no access-control enforcement)**:
- [ ] Confirm `_commit_in_place` / `_clear_in_place` are NOT reachable through a variable statically typed as `GridStateReader` (i.e., not declared on the base class, only on `GridSnapshot`/`GridSystem`)
- [ ] Confirm no public API returns a `GridSnapshot`-typed reference — all public snapshot-returning methods must be typed `GridStateReader`

### GRID-007 — Serialization and Deserialization (Integration)
**Test file path**: `tests/integration/grid_system/grid_serialization_test.gd`
**What to test** (from story AC-C8.1–C8.10):
- Full round-trip: multi-op sequence (including ≥1 rotation ≠ 0°) → `serialize()` → `deserialize()` into a fresh instance → per-cell `occupant_id`/`access_ids` equal for every cell, per-id `get_access_cells()` equal (AC-C8.1)
- Rotation value survives the round-trip via the reverse index, not the raw arrays (AC-C8.2)
- Deterministic output: identical Dictionary regardless of commit insertion order; records sorted ascending by `instance_id`; cells within a record sorted `(y,x)` lexicographic (AC-C8.3)
- Save→load→save stability: `S_A == S_B` full deep equality (AC-C8.3b)
- **All 4 error categories, each intercepted at the correct phase, before any write**:
  - `LEVEL_GEOMETRY_MISMATCH` — footprint on wall (AC-C8.4), access on wall (AC-C8.5, same code as footprint — both are "geometry mismatch"), dimension mismatch (AC-C8.6, short-circuits before any record processing)
  - `CORRUPTED_SAVE_OUT_OF_BOUNDS` — intercepted before any `PackedArray` write occurs (AC-C8.7)
  - `CORRUPTED_SAVE_OVERLAP` — footprint-footprint overlap only; access-access overlap is explicitly allowed (AC-C8.8)
- **No partial recovery**: 5 valid records + 1 corrupt record → `get_snapshot()` shows the initial empty state, not "5 committed" (AC-C8.9) — this is the two-phase Validate/Commit structural guarantee, test it directly
- Single `grid_changed` emission on successful deserialize, covering the union of all records' cells — not one emission per record (AC-C8.10)

**Edge cases to cover**:
- Include equipment with 0 access cells and equipment rotated 90°/270° in the round-trip fixture
- Width-mismatch-only, height-mismatch-only, and both-mismatch dimension test cases
- Negative coordinate and exactly-at-`width` (off-by-one) OOB coordinates
- Partial vs full footprint overlap
- Signal count with 1 record and with 0 records (empty save — must NOT emit, since nothing changed)

**Estimated test count**: ~18–20 integration tests (highest AC count of any story this sprint)

*Note: `buildable_snapshot` is supplied externally by the level loader, not part of the save blob — test fixtures must construct this separately, matching ADR-0002.*

### GRID-008 — Signals, Integration, and Performance (Integration)
**Test file paths** (3 required, per story's own Test Evidence section):
- `tests/unit/grid_system/grid_system_signals_test.gd` (AC-C7.4, AC-C7.5, AC-C7.6)
- `tests/integration/grid_system/grid_navigation_solidity_test.gd` (AC-X.1)
- `tests/integration/grid_system/grid_perf_drag_smoke_test.gd` (AC-PERF.3)

**What to test**:
- `commit()` emits `grid_changed` exactly once with the exact footprint/access cell sets, no extras/omissions (AC-C7.4)
- `clear()` emits exactly once with the **same** arrays as commit (field names carry no direction — subscribers must re-query, not infer). Test must explicitly assert `is_solid((1,1)) == false` post-signal, proving the re-query contract, not just that a signal fired (AC-C7.5)
- Drag-preview signal isolation: repeated `get_speculative_snapshot()` calls emit **zero** signals; only the eventual `commit()` produces exactly 1 (AC-C7.6)
- Navigation integration: an access-only cell (no footprint) reads as non-solid via the solidity snapshot path Navigation consumes (AC-X.1)
- `get_occupant_id()` returns a bare `int`, with no type-level coupling to what equipment/instance it represents (AC-X.4)
- **Guardrail tests (AC-NEG.1, AC-NEG.2)** — these exist to stop future developers from leaking reachability logic into GridSystem:
  - Access-cell contention between two equipments never flips `is_solid` to `true` (AC-NEG.1)
  - An equipment whose access cells are fully boxed in by other footprints must produce **zero** reachability signal across all 8 public APIs enumerated in the story (`can_place`, `commit`, `is_solid`, `get_occupant_id`, `get_access_cells`, `get_snapshot`, `get_speculative_snapshot`, `serialize`) — test must enumerate all 8, partial coverage defeats the guardrail's purpose
- **Performance smoke test (AC-PERF.3, BLOCKING)**: 300 consecutive `get_speculative_snapshot()` calls on a 130-cell room with 5-6 placed equipment and sparse (8-15% fill) access cells, varying anchor per call (not a repeated identical delta) — total < 50ms, per-call max < 5ms (first call excluded from max, still counted in total)

**Edge cases to cover**:
- Multiple sequential commits — each must produce exactly 1 signal, not a running total
- 2×2 footprint and rotation=90° cases for the clear-side symmetry test
- 3+ and 5+ equipments sharing the same access cell for AC-NEG.1
- Fixture must use *sparse*, *varying* deltas for AC-PERF.3 — a dense or repeated-delta fixture would silently pass a broken implementation

**Estimated test count**: ~16–18 tests across the 3 files (7 functional ACs + 1 performance smoke test + guardrail enumeration)

**Code review checklist item (AC-NEG.1/NEG.2/X.4 — partially advisory)**:
- [ ] New public methods added to `GridSystem` after this story are checked against the AC-NEG.2 list of 8 surfaces for accidental reachability leakage
- [ ] `get_occupant_id()` signature/body confirmed to do no type inspection or validation of the id's meaning

## Manual QA Checklist

No Visual/Feel or UI stories in this sprint — GridSystem is a pure backend/data system. The only non-automated items are the **code review checklist entries** listed inline above (AC-GSR.3 in GRID-006; AC-NEG.1/NEG.2/X.4 partial coverage in GRID-008). These are ADVISORY, not BLOCKING — `/story-done` should confirm they were checked but does not gate on a failing automated test for them, since GDScript has no compile-time access control to assert against.

## Smoke Test Scope

Critical paths to verify before QA hand-off for this sprint (`/smoke-check sprint`):

1. `godot --headless --script tests/headless_runner.gd` exits 0 — the full registered suite passes (contract fixed in commit `299461b`; verified working in CI run `30552386098`)
2. No test file exists on disk that is unregistered in `tests/headless_runner.gd`'s `TEST_FILES`/`PENDING_FILES` — the runner's `_check_registry_coverage()` catches this automatically
3. `AC-PERF.3` (GRID-008 drag smoke test) passes under `godot --headless` specifically — CI hardware may differ from local dev; the 50ms/300-call threshold is deliberately loose (catches "1000× slower", not "10% slower") to absorb that variance
4. GridSystem's own round-trip: a manual `serialize()` → `deserialize()` → `serialize()` sanity check via the new integration test, confirming Story 007's mechanism works end-to-end
5. The two still-quarantined tests (`tests/smoke/core_smoke_test.gd`, `tests/integration/core_loop/core_loop_test.gd`) continue to print as `SKIPPED`, not silently vanish — this sprint does NOT unblock them (unblock needs time-system story-003's `SeededRNG` in addition to GRID-002/004/005/006)

*Smoke tests are verified by the developer via `/smoke-check`. Reference this list when running that skill.*

## Playtest Requirements

No playtest sessions required for this sprint. GridSystem is a Foundation-layer backend system with no player-facing surface — its correctness is fully covered by automated Logic/Integration tests. Playtest validation applies once PlacementSystem/UI consume GridSystem (a later epic).

## Definition of Done — This Sprint

A story is DONE when ALL of the following are true:

- [ ] All acceptance criteria verified — via automated test result OR documented manual evidence (code review checklist item, for the ADVISORY items only)
- [ ] Test file exists at the specified path for all 7 stories (all are Logic or Integration)
- [ ] New test files are registered in `tests/headless_runner.gd`'s `TEST_FILES` array — verified automatically by `_check_registry_coverage()`
- [ ] Smoke check passes (run `/smoke-check sprint` before QA hand-off) — includes the AC-PERF.3 performance gate
- [ ] No regressions introduced — the two quarantined tests remain quarantined (not un-registered, not silently deleted)
- [ ] Code reviewed (via `/code-review`) — with special attention to GRID-003 (highest risk in sprint: rotation union-bbox) and GRID-008's AC-NEG guardrails
- [ ] Story file updated to `Status: Complete` (via `/story-done`)
